title: Finding the Sweet Spot: Preference Data Construction for Scaling Preference Optimization
authors_zh: Yao Xiao, Hai Ye, Linyao Chen, Hwee Tou Ng, Lidong Bing, Xiaoli Li, Roy Ka-Wei Lee
paper_type_zh: 在线偏好数据构造研究
best_for_zh: 扩展 DPO 回答采样且不想盲目使用最大—最小对的读者。
one_line: The paper constructs DPO pairs from reward-distribution positions, preferring a μ−2σ rejected response over the minimum.
该工作按奖励分布位置构造 DPO 对，优先使用均值减二倍标准差的拒绝回答而非最小值。
why: It turns a reward-ranked response pool into a calibrated pair-selection policy for the DPO training consumer.
inclusion_reason: It directly determines which generated chosen and rejected responses are consumed by DPO as on-policy sample scale increases.

title: Problem
问题
html:
On-policy preference construction commonly samples several responses per prompt, chooses the highest reward as chosen and the lowest reward as rejected, and trains DPO on that pair. When sampling is scaled from a handful to hundreds of responses, this max-min rule can become worse rather than better: the minimum can be an outlier that provides an unhelpful learning contrast, while more samples increase the chance of such extremes.

This paper asks how the two records in a DPO pair should be selected from a prompt-specific reward distribution as the number of on-policy samples grows. It changes the preference data consumed by DPO, not the DPO loss. The target is a pair with a meaningful reward separation but a rejected answer that remains a useful negative, so expanding generation budget improves rather than destabilizes post-training.

在线偏好数据构造通常为每个提示采样若干回答，选择最高奖励作为偏好回答、最低奖励作为拒绝回答，并在该对上训练 DPO。当采样从少量扩展到数百条时，这种最大—最小规则可能变差而非变好：最小值可能是无法提供有用学习对比的离群点，而更多样本增加了出现这类极端值的概率。

本文追问随着每个提示的在线样本数增长，应如何从提示特定的奖励分布中选择 DPO 对中的两条记录。它改变的是 DPO 消费的偏好数据，而非 DPO 损失。目标是既有有意义奖励间隔、又让拒绝回答仍是有用负例的一对，使扩展生成预算能改善而非破坏后训练。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
For every prompt, the method fits the sampled reward scores with a normal distribution and represents the response pool by seven positions: minimum, mean minus two and one standard deviations, mean, mean plus one and two standard deviations, and maximum. It evaluates all 21 ordered chosen–rejected combinations rather than assuming the most distant observed pair is best.

The empirical sweet spot selects a high chosen response—typically maximum or mean plus two standard deviations—but uses mean minus two standard deviations as rejected rather than the absolute minimum. The proposal is therefore a construction rule over a reward distribution: preserve a substantial, controlled margin while avoiding an excessively pathological rejection. This distinction determines which two generated answers become the training record for every prompt.

对每个提示，方法用正态分布拟合采样奖励分数，并以七个位置表示回答池：最小值、均值减二和一倍标准差、均值、均值加一和二倍标准差以及最大值。它评估全部 21 个有序的偏好—拒绝组合，而非假定观测距离最远的一对最佳。

经验上的甜点选择高质量的偏好回答——通常是最大值或均值加二倍标准差——却把均值减二倍标准差而非绝对最小值作为拒绝回答。因此该提议是一条奖励分布上的构造规则：保持显著且可控的间隔，同时避免过度病态的拒绝例。这一区别决定每个提示的哪两条生成回答成为训练记录。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors start from SFT models and sample responses to UltraFeedback prompts with temperature 0.8, using the Armorm reward model to score each response. In the main distribution study, 200 responses per prompt are sampled, a mean and standard deviation are estimated, the seven representative responses closest to specified reward positions are identified, and 21 preference datasets are constructed. A separate DPO policy is trained for every pair type to isolate the effect of chosen/rejected positions.

The case study evaluates LLaMA-3-8B and Mistral-7B in base and instruction-tuned settings. Base models are first SFT-trained on UltraChat-200K; instruction settings begin from the public instruct checkpoints. The final scalable strategy samples a larger response pool, chooses the best high-reward response, and uses the response nearest mean minus two standard deviations as rejected. Evaluation uses AlpacaEval 2 win rate and length-controlled win rate. The paper releases code and constructed data at its official repository.

作者从监督微调模型出发，以温度 0.8 对 UltraFeedback 提示采样回答，并用 Armorm 奖励模型评分。在主分布研究中，每个提示采样 200 个回答，估计均值和标准差，找出最接近指定奖励位置的七个代表回答，并构造 21 个偏好数据集。每种对类型都训练单独 DPO 策略，以隔离偏好与拒绝位置的影响。

案例研究在基础和指令微调设置中评估 LLaMA-3-8B 与 Mistral-7B。基础模型先在 UltraChat-200K 上做监督微调；指令设置从公开指令检查点开始。最终的可扩展策略从更大回答池中选择最佳高奖励回答，并把最接近均值减二倍标准差的回答作为拒绝回答。评测使用 AlpacaEval 2 胜率和长度控制胜率。论文在官方仓库发布代码和构造数据。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The conventional max-min pipeline does not improve monotonically when responses per prompt increase from 5 to 200; the paper reports fluctuating or declining AlpacaEval 2 scores across all four LLaMA/Mistral base and instruct settings. In the 21-pair analysis with 200 samples, the best choices consistently use a rejected response near mean minus two standard deviations. For LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct, the pair of mean plus two standard deviations chosen and mean minus two standard deviations rejected reaches a 48.18% length-controlled win rate, about three points above the conventional construction.

The ablation heatmaps show small reward margins perform poorly: for LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct, pairing mean plus two standard deviations with mean plus one standard deviation gives 34.63% length-controlled win rate. Extending candidate positions to mean plus/minus three or four standard deviations does not yield a material improvement over the relevant extremes. The paper also reports that none of the evaluated preference-pair choices falls below the SFT checkpoint, but its main outcome is AlpacaEval 2, so the chosen reward distribution and evaluator remain central to how broadly the conclusion should be applied.

传统最大—最小流程在每个提示回答数从 5 增至 200 时并不单调改进；论文报告在四个 LLaMA/Mistral 基础和指令设置中 AlpacaEval 2 分数会波动或下降。在使用 200 个样本的 21 对分析中，最佳选择持续使用接近均值减二倍标准差的拒绝回答。对 LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct，偏好为均值加二倍标准差、拒绝为均值减二倍标准差的一对达到 48.18% 长度控制胜率，比传统构造约高三点。

消融热图显示小奖励间隔表现较差：对 LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct，将均值加二倍标准差与均值加一倍标准差配对只得到 34.63% 长度控制胜率。将候选位置扩展到均值加减三或四倍标准差，相对相关极端并未带来实质提升。论文还报告没有任何已评估偏好对选择低于监督微调检查点，但其主要结果是 AlpacaEval 2，因此所选奖励分布和评测器仍是结论可泛化程度的核心。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior scalable DPO pipelines often regard reward ranking as sufficient: highest is chosen and lowest is rejected. This work makes the rejected response a first-class design decision and tests it systematically over a prompt-local distribution. It changes data construction at the level that DPO actually sees, showing that a larger observed margin is not necessarily a better learning signal.

The contribution is not a new reward model or an alternate pairwise objective. It is a calibrated sampling policy that uses mean and variance to choose representative response positions, then identifies a reusable high-versus-moderately-low pair. The seven-point grid and 21 pair datasets make the claim falsifiable: the reported optimum must beat both max-min and nearby reward intervals under the same DPO recipe.

早期可扩展 DPO 流程常把奖励排序视为充分条件：最高为偏好、最低为拒绝。该工作把拒绝回答作为一等设计决策，并在提示局部分布上系统测试它。它在 DPO 实际看到的层面改变数据构造，表明更大的观测间隔未必是更好的学习信号。

其贡献不是新的奖励模型或替代的成对目标，而是一种使用均值和方差选择代表回答位置、再识别可复用的高质量对中等偏低质量对的校准采样策略。七点网格和 21 个对数据集使主张可被证伪：报告的最优必须在相同 DPO 配方下胜过最大—最小和相邻奖励区间。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The approach assumes reward distributions can be usefully approximated by a normal form and depends on the chosen reward model; skewed, multimodal, or poorly calibrated rewards can change which response lies near a nominal standard-deviation position. Generating 200 candidates and training 21 DPO models is an expensive analysis, even if the final construction rule is simpler. Evidence centers on UltraFeedback prompts, Armorm scores, four 7B/8B model settings, and AlpacaEval 2, so it does not prove that the same mean-minus-two-standard-deviation negative is optimal for safety, reasoning, multilingual, or highly constrained preferences. The paper also notes that the reward model's own limits and sampling temperature affect the pool.

该方法假设奖励分布可被正态形式有效近似，并依赖所选奖励模型；偏斜、多峰或校准不佳的奖励可能改变哪条回答靠近名义标准差位置。生成 200 个候选并训练 21 个 DPO 模型是昂贵分析，即使最终构造规则更简单。证据集中于 UltraFeedback 提示、Armorm 分数、四个 7B/8B 模型设置和 AlpacaEval 2，因此不能证明同一均值减二倍标准差负例对安全、推理、多语言或高度约束偏好最优。论文还指出奖励模型本身的局限和采样温度会影响回答池。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this construction strategy when producing on-policy DPO data with enough candidates per prompt to estimate a response-level reward distribution. Preserve the base policy, prompts, sample count, decoding temperature, reward model and version, per-prompt scores, fitted mean and standard deviation, mapping from reward positions to actual response IDs, selected pair IDs, and DPO hyperparameters. Compare the proposed pair to max-min at the same generation and training budget, and inspect whether the selected rejected response is syntactically valid and policy-relevant rather than merely numerically near a threshold. The official repository is the source for implementation and released data, but it does not replace reward-model or generated-text auditing.

当生成在线 DPO 数据且每个提示有足够候选来估计回答级奖励分布时，可使用此构造策略。应保留基础策略、提示、样本数、解码温度、奖励模型与版本、逐提示分数、拟合均值和标准差、从奖励位置到实际回答标识的映射、所选对标识和 DPO 超参数。应在相同生成和训练预算下把提议对与最大—最小比较，并检查所选拒绝回答在语法上有效且与策略相关，而不只是数值上靠近阈值。官方仓库是实现和发布数据的来源，却不能替代对奖励模型或生成文本的审计。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The important result is not simply that reward margins should be large. The paper finds that the absolute lowest response becomes a worse negative as sampling reveals more extreme tails, whereas a response around mean minus two standard deviations retains a productive contrast. Read the seven reward positions as a diagnostic tool for a particular reward distribution, not as universal absolute scores. The most direct replication is to reproduce the 21-pair grid on a new policy and reward model before adopting the final pair rule at scale.
重要结果不只是奖励间隔应当大。论文发现当采样揭示更多极端尾部时，绝对最低回答会成为更差的负例，而约在均值减二倍标准差的回答保留了有效对比。应把七个奖励位置理解为某一奖励分布的诊断工具，而非普适的绝对分数。最直接的复现是在新策略和奖励模型上先重现 21 对网格，再大规模采用最终配对规则。
